1.web: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, drew near.
1.asv: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

2.web: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.
2.asv: And the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death; for they feared the people.

3.web: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was numbered with the twelve.
3.asv: And Satan entered into Judas who was called Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

4.web: He went away, and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.
4.asv: And he went away, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might deliver him unto them.

5.web: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.
5.asv: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

6.web: He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.
6.asv: And he consented, and sought opportunity to deliver him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

7.web: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.
7.asv: And the day of unleavened bread came, on which the passover must be sacrificed.

8.web: He sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”
8.asv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and make ready for us the passover, that we may eat.

9.web: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”
9.asv: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we make ready?

10.web: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.
10.asv: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house whereinto he goeth.

11.web: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
11.asv: And ye shall say unto the master of the house, The Teacher saith unto thee, Where is the guest-chamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

12.web: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”
12.asv: And he will show you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

13.web: They went, found things as he had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
13.asv: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

14.web: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.
14.asv: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the apostles with him.

15.web: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,
15.asv: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

16.web: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in the Kingdom of God.”
16.asv: for I say unto you, I shall not eat it, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

17.web: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this, and share it among yourselves,
17.asv: And he received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

18.web: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until the Kingdom of God comes.”
18.asv: for I say unto you, I shall not drink from henceforth of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

19.web: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it, and gave to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”
19.asv: And he took bread, and when he had given thanks, he brake it, and gave to them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

20.web: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
20.asv: And the cup in like manner after supper, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood, even that which is poured out for you.

21.web: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.
21.asv: But behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

22.web: The Son of Man indeed goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”
22.asv: For the Son of man indeed goeth, as it hath been determined: but woe unto that man through whom he is betrayed!

23.web: They began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.
23.asv: And they began to question among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

24.web: There arose also a contention among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.
24.asv: And there arose also a contention among them, which of them was accounted to be greatest.

25.web: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’
25.asv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles have lordship over them; and they that have authority over them are called Benefactors.

26.web: But not so with you. But one who is the greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.
26.asv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is the greater among you, let him become as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

27.web: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am in your midst as one who serves.
27.asv: For which is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am in the midst of you as he that serveth.

28.web: But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.
28.asv: But ye are they that have continued with me in my temptations;

29.web: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,
29.asv: and I appoint unto you a kingdom, even as my Father appointed unto me,

30.web: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”
30.asv: that ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom; and ye shall sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

31.web: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have you, that he might sift you as wheat,
31.asv: Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have you, that he might sift you as wheat:

32.web: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
32.asv: but I made supplication for thee, that thy faith fail not; and do thou, when once thou hast turned again, establish thy brethren.

33.web: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”
33.asv: And he said unto him, Lord, with thee I am ready to go both to prison and to death.

34.web: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”
34.asv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, until thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

35.web: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, and wallet, and shoes, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
35.asv: And he said unto them, When I sent you forth without purse, and wallet, and shoes, lacked ye anything? And they said, Nothing.

36.web: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.
36.asv: And he said unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet; and he that hath none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

37.web: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me has an end.”
37.asv: For I say unto you, that this which is written must be fulfilled in me, And he was reckoned with transgressors: for that which concerneth me hath fulfilment.

38.web: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”
38.asv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

39.web: He came out, and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.
39.asv: And he came out, and went, as his custom was, unto the mount of Olives; and the disciples also followed him.

40.web: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”
40.asv: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

41.web: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,
41.asv: And he was parted from them about a stone’s cast; and he kneeled down and prayed,

42.web: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”
42.asv: saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

43.web: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.
43.asv: And there appeared unto him an angel from heaven, strengthening him.

44.web: Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.
44.asv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became as it were great drops of blood falling down upon the ground.

45.web: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples, and found them sleeping because of grief,
45.asv: And when he rose up from his prayer, he came unto the disciples, and found them sleeping for sorrow,

46.web: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”
46.asv: and said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, that ye enter not into temptation.

47.web: While he was still speaking, behold, a multitude, and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.
47.asv: While he yet spake, behold, a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them; and he drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

48.web: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”
48.asv: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

49.web: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”
49.asv: And when they that were about him saw what would follow, they said, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

50.web: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
50.asv: And a certain one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his right ear.

51.web: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear, and healed him.
51.asv: But Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye them thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

52.web: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?
52.asv: And Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and elders, that were come against him, Are ye come out, as against a robber, with swords and staves?

53.web: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”
53.asv: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched not forth your hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

54.web: They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.
54.asv: And they seized him, and led himaway, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed afar off.

55.web: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard, and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.
55.asv: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the court, and had sat down together, Peter sat in the midst of them.

56.web: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”
56.asv: And a certain maid seeing him as he sat in the light of the fire, and looking stedfastly upon him, said, This man also was with him.

57.web: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”
57.asv: But he denied, saying, Woman, I know him not.

58.web: After a little while someone else saw him, and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”
58.asv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou also art one of them. But Peter said, Man, I am not.

59.web: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”
59.asv: And after the space of about one hour another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this man also was with him; for he is a Galilæan.

60.web: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
60.asv: But Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.

61.web: The Lord turned, and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”
61.asv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how that he said unto him, Before the cock crow this day thou shalt deny me thrice.

62.web: He went out, and wept bitterly.
62.asv: And he went out, and wept bitterly.

63.web: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.
63.asv: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and beat him.

64.web: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
64.asv: And they blindfolded him, and asked him, saying, Prophesy: who is he that struck thee?

65.web: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.
65.asv: And many other things spake they against him, reviling him.

66.web: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people was gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,
66.asv: And as soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people was gathered together, both chief priests and scribes; and they led him away into their council, saying,

67.web: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,
67.asv: If thou art the Christ, tell us. But he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

68.web: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.
68.asv: and if I ask you, ye will not answer.

69.web: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
69.asv: But from henceforth shall the Son of man be seated at the right hand of the power of God.

70.web: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”
70.asv: And they all said, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

71.web: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”
71.asv: And they said, What further need have we of witness? for we ourselves have heard from his own mouth.
